title: Add shared application port and CLI for editor LSP bridge
description: Extract semantic operations and action cache from MCP into a typed application service. Add HTTP inbound adapter and thin CLI client with flags, JSON/stdin, workspace inference, schemas and shared results. Verify real analyzer and cross-adapter action IDs.

notes.text: Shared typed Application now owns semantic dispatch and action cache; MCP and HTTP use the same instance and generated schemas. CLI supports flags, JSON/stdin, Cargo workspace inference and structured errors. Real-analyzer integration passed, including shared analyzer PID and applying code actions across MCP/CLI in both directions. Finishing full checks, release installation and live-core verification.

Full cargo test, clippy -D warnings, real-analyzer integration and release build passed. Installed bridge and mcp-editor-lsp-bridge via cargo install. Restarted the existing core; installed CLI returned ready=true and a connected Zed companion. Live stdin symbols query succeeded. Demo contains a user test syntax error, correctly reported and left intact.

Documentation and installation complete. Concise repository-maintained skill linked into ~/.codex/skills and ~/.pi/agent/skills; skill-creator validator passed using available Anaconda Python. CLI and core are live on port 47831, Zed companion connected. All requested implementation and verification complete; no Zed extension rebuild required.
